entries.hindi_translation: Khrabb is a rituals object used in mishmi pujas like tano , thung, talu etc.It is distributed as a short calender and also as an invitation.each knot in the khrabb represent one day, and by counting the knots people know the date of the puja. entries.about_image: An wan "Humbaram" (Fermented soya bean) . An wan shao hamang , Humbaram an wan Balae (soyabean) ka achao nai hamang . an wan barong kayin sam kasar nak kakiyar . kasar wan baar ne ka kasar phu kat nam tao hamang . Kakiyar wan ko boyan hi shan ne ka tha man tao hamang. An wan niyam man hamang wahi chaong yong mara tao hamang. Humbaram an wan tilang , wifha so hamank man hamang
entries.hindi_translation: it is called "Humbaram" (Fermented Soya bean) . it is a local soyabean ball .it is made of soya (Balae) which is grown in farms locally. Humbaram are of two type one is dry and other is semi grevy texture. The dry one is made into small ball and keep it for drying while the semi gravy one is directly filled in container. Humbaram has a strong flavour and odour, due to which it is not like by some people but it is also widely consumed.

entries.about_image: Mathakta pirmliba mami asi manipuri da ngari hyna khangnei. Ngari hybasi nga bu kuina thammaga pathalaga semba potsakni. Ngari asi kangsoi thongbada amasung singju twbada ymna maru oina sijinnaba potsak amani. Ngari hybasi meitei amagidi ymna maru oiba hingbada chngdraba yadraba potsak amani.
entries.hindi_translation: The above image is of fermented fish which is known as ngari in manipuri language. They are made from fish by making the fish fermented in this way we can keep them for a long time . They are used in making vegetables stew known as kangsoi and singju which is a manipuri salad . They are an essential thing in a Meitei's life.

entries.about_image: Masigi shaktam asi Ushingsha gi mahei haina khangnei. Masisu chanaba chinjak amani. Masi ayambana maru marang oina sijinnei . Aduga hidak oinasu sijinnaba yaowi.
entries.hindi_translation: The given image is known as Ceylon cinnamon. In Manipuri language it is called Ushingsha. It is used as spices for Meitei community. Maru Marang is the name of the word spices in manipuri.

entries.about_image: Asomar poribeshot onayase kheti koribo para ebidh dailjatiyo shosyo hol rohor mah. I pustir utsa aru asomiya randhanshailit iyar jothesto chahida ase jodiyo utpadon kom howar babe amdani koriblogia hoy. Asomar poribesh rohor mahor khetir babe upojugi buli krishi bisheshagyasokol nishchit hoise. Ghoror choupashor eneye pori thoka mati, okho potito mati, pukhurir par, barir khali mati adit rohor mahor kheti kori ashatitobhabe labhowan hobo pari. Anyanno dailjatiyo shosyor dore rohor mahor khetit bor bisesh lagio thakibo nalage, khorcho bor kom.

entries.about_image: नोआ दो होड़ेक दल काना।होड़ेक दल दु कु उतुय दा,आर जोतो आड़ाक रेहो कु लगाव दा।आर नोआ रेनाक चटनी हों बेनाक काना।आर होड़ेक दो दाक रेकु डालाव दा आर उना दाक दुकु नुय दा,आओकाटा दो रान गी।होड़ेक दल दो पथरी रेकु रान ऐदा।
entries.hindi_translation: ये कुरथी का दाल है। ये दाल में साग को मिला के भी खाया जाता है ओर इसका चटनी भी बनाया जाता है। और कुरथी दाल का पानी को पिया जाता है जो दवाई में काम करता है। विशेष कर पथरी के लिए ये दाल बहुत जरूरी है।

entries.about_image: नोवा दो सिंज दारे काना। नोवा दारे दो बिर बुरू आर आतो कोरे हो ञामोक्आ काना। नोवा दारे दो अमा लेकानाग कामी रे लगा काना। नोवा दारे दो साहान हो होयोक्आ आर जो ते दोको जोमा आर साकाम दो पूजा रे लागा काना।
entries.hindi_translation: ये पेड़ बेल का पेड़ है। ये पेड़ पहाड़ , जंगल और गांव में पाया जाता है। ये पेड़ पूजा एवं जलावान के काम में आता है।

entries.about_image: नेअः मेथी आड़ाः खेती तनाः। नेअः के बाखड़ी रेको हेरेः ओड़ो हारा कोः रे अंदा याको। मेथी आड़ाः जोम लेरे ठंडा रे होड़मो लोलो ताइना, लैअं मजा पचावगा ओड़ोः नेअः के रीईं केते ऊंब कोरे को लगावना।
entries.hindi_translation: यह मेथी साग की खेती है। इसे बगान में लगाया जाता है और बढ़ने पर इसे सब्जी पकाया जाता है। मेथी साग खाने से ठंडा में शरीर गर्म रहता है, पाचनतंत्र में सुधार होता है और इसे पीसकर बालों में लगाया जाता है।

entries.about_image: Khiungyin
entries.hindi_translation: This is called Khiungyin in Yimkhiung language. This is a dried basil flower and it is used as a taste enhancer. It is an herb. This is used in curries and especially good in meat curries. This is one of the taste enhancers of Nagas and makes the curry flavorful.

entries.about_image: Gunda pata laga jor
entries.hindi_translation: This is called Gunda Pata Jor, in English it is fish mint root. It is eaten as chutney or we can put it in curries. It has good health benefits.
